notes.title: Idol Hands – Updates, Mac and Linux support!
notes.content:
Pocket Games is extremely excited to bring new platform support and an update of major improvements to Idol Hands. We are committed to optimising the game for our players and are working hard on new content for the future. So return to your Furling followers and lead them against the onslaught of the Red God!

This update includes:
[list]
[*] The game is now available for Mac and Linux users
[*] Steam Cloud is now supported
[*] We’ve revitalised the tutorial levels with new text and onscreen prompts
[*] We listened to the community and implemented WASD movement and Right Click camera rotation
[*] Key bindings for skills have been simplified and we’ve included visual cues in the HUD (Turn on/off with the ‘i’ Key)
[*] The game text has had a major overhaul
[*] Improved combat health bars to make it easier to distinguish between friendlies and enemies
[*] General mission balancing and AI improvements all around
[/list]
God Powers have also been improved:
[list]
[*] Lightning can be used to insta-kill a single enemy unit whilst damaging those around it
[*] Lightning and Meteors can now be used directly on the enemy Origin Stone
[/list]

notes.title: Delivering you another bounty of new updates!
notes.content:
You'd be forgiven for thinking that we truly have godly powers as we've been working the land, night and day, to deliver you another bounty of new updates for Idol Hands!

[list] 
[*]Health bars on buildings - bash away furlings!
[*]Ability to disable the spinning effect for earthquakes, meteors, and volcanoes - see all the action straight up. 
[*]Ability to disable the jumping to enemy attacks using earthquakes, meteors, and volcanoes.
[*]Ability to skip Old One speech using a key - our Furling OAP supportline is going to be quiet.
[*]Ability to increase game speed temporarily, so you can speed up game play - MORE power to YOU!
[*]Ability to move around overhead map using same controls as main map - WASD, LMB dragging, RMB rotating.

notes.title: Now is the perfect time to get your hands on Idol Hands!
notes.content:
Thanks to the amazing feedback from the community, IDOL HANDS gets its first major update an update which is now LIVE and includes the following:
 
-       The implementation of WASD and arrow keys for moving forward, backward, left and right. You will also still be able to use the left mouse button to drag the landscape if you desire.

-       The ability to zoom the camera in/out using the mouse wheel or the -/= keys.

-       The ability to press the right mouse button to rotate camera but now with the added ability to use the more traditional conventions of moving the mouse left/right.

-       The ability to skip the initial start-up videos by pressing any key.

-       The ability to skip each of the four tutorials using a Skip button.

-       The addition of the following extra key mappings for using with the WASD keys (previous key mappings will still also work):

 1 = Rain
 2 = Lightning
 3 = Earthquake
 4 = Meteor
 5 = Volcano
 Z = Lower Land
 X = Flatten Land
 C = Raise Land

notes.title: Idol Hands Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Thanks to amazing feedback from the Idol Hands community, we are pleased to announce there will be an update coming to the game on 5TH MARCH 2015.
 
This will include:
-        The ability to press any key to skip through the logos video section of the game.

-        The ability to press any key to skip through the four tutorials.

-        The implementation of WASD keys for moving forward, backwards and strafing left/right. You will still be able to use LMB to drag the landscape if you desire.

-        A change to the mapping of hot keys to match WASD layout; T for totem, YUIOP for godly powers and ZXC for terraforming. +/- for zoom (with localised WASD hot key updates coming in the future).

-        The ability to use the Right Mouse Button + left/right movement to rotate camera. 

-        The ability to zoom the camera in/out using the mouse wheel or (+/- hot keys). 

We really value everyone’s feedback so please continue to let us know how we can improve the game! We will have more updates and Idol Hands DLC news coming very soon!
